fluff.overview: The Armed Forces of the Federated Suns integrate conventional infantry directly into their Regimental Combat Teams, assigning foot, mechanized, and jump platoons to work permanently alongside BattleMech and armored formations. Foot infantry remain the backbone of AFFS planetary garrisons, cheap enough to deploy in numbers across the Federated Suns' vast territory and reliable enough to hold ground that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Supplementing their rifles with portable machine guns that provide sustained automatic fire, these platoons anchor defensive positions with suppressive capability that pins attacking infantry and discourages unarmored vehicles from closing.
